title: Clock-tape configuration decomposition
statement: Let $K$ be a natural number, let $\Gamma,P,Q$ be types, and let $d$ be a configuration with $K+2$ work tapes whose state is $(\mathrm{true},q)$ for some $q\in Q$. Then $d$ is obtained by mapping the state of a configuration with $K+1$ work tapes to $(\mathrm{true},\cdot)$, where that smaller configuration has state $p$ for some $p\in P$, retains the input position and output of $d$, and uses the first $K+1$ tapes of $d$; the additional last tape and its head position are the last tape and head position of $d$.
hypotheses_covered: $K$ is a natural number; $\Gamma,P,Q$ are types
$d$ is a configuration on a fixed input with $K+2$ work tapes
